d: Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (remote, work from home) | Employment type: Full-time | Experience level: Entry level

More of Namaa Partners' performance improvement work now comes from companies in Saudi Arabia, so we are adding a Performance Analyst in the Kingdom. You will set up and track the measures our clients use to run their businesses: you define KPIs with client teams, gather the monthly figures and report where results differ from plan and why. It is a full-time remote role, worked from home anywhere in Saudi Arabia. Our principals sit in Oklahoma City, eight to nine hours behind Riyadh, so a few meetings each week start late in your afternoon.
Agree KPIs, targets and the source of each figure with client teams
Gather monthly results from business units and compare them with plan and the prior year
Prepare performance reports and dashboards for management meetings
Look into the largest variances with the people responsible and write down the causes
Track the actions agreed in performance reviews and report their progress
Namaa Partners is a management consulting firm in Oklahoma City. A typical project might be a board mandate, a new organization design or a comparison of investment options for a group.
Bachelor's in business, economics, finance, engineering or a related field
Excel, including pivot tables and charts
PowerPoint: you can turn a table of results into a clear slide
Some experience in reporting, planning or analysis, including internships
Experience in a strategy office, PMO or performance management team
Medical insurance for you and your family
25 days of paid annual leave and the Saudi public holidays
End-of-service award as set by the Saudi Labor Law
Budget each year for courses and certificates
Laptop and home office equipment from Namaa
